messages:
Alex R: Quick kickoff for Nimbus pilot onboarding tomorrow 10am PT. Maya, Jorge, Priya, Sam, Liam, Devin — can we confirm owners, success criteria, and any blockers? I'll drop a short runbook below.

Maya C: I can own CS ops + weekly cadence. Action: I'll set a recurring 30m Wed standup (invite out in 10m).

Jorge L: I'll own integration/infra. Primary blockers: SSO (SAML) + customer needs audit logs to their SIEM. Also EU data residency proof requested. ETA: SSO by next Tue if we get certs today.

Sam T: For SSO I need their metadata + a test user. I can spin up a test env on dev-dedicated. Also want to confirm model variant — Nimbus prefers int8 quantized for cost.

Priya S: Customer success criteria (as stated by PM): 1) end-to-end SSO sign-in, 2) p95 latency <= 200ms for sample flows, 3) process first 5k monthly tokens without errors. Renewal risk: if not live in 45 days risk -> medium. I'll own renewal milestones and escalate if we drift.

Liam K: Enablement plan: 2x 60m sessions — Dev deep-dive + Product demo. Proposed slots: Tue 4/18 11am PT (dev) and Thu 4/20 2pm PT (product). Can everyone make those? If not we move.

Devin P: Security/legal asks: SOC2 evidence + KMS integration proof. Also need DPA + SSO assertion example. Starting the security questionnaire now. Customer legal contact needed. Link to questionnaire: https://redwood-infra.example.com/sec-q/12345

OnboardBot: New ticket created: CS-4821 - Nimbus onboarding runbook (https://tracker.redwood.dev/CS-4821) assigned to Maya C, Jorge L, Priya S.

Alex R: Quick action list: Sam -> SSO doc + test env creds by EOD; Jorge -> cert exchange owner; Maya -> invite + kickoff agenda; Devin -> sec questionnaire + legal contact; Priya -> define renewal milestones & NRR signals. I'll follow up after the first sync. :rocket:

Maya C: Agenda draft: 1) Intros 2) Success criteria & risks 3) Tech checklist 4) Timeline & milestones 5) Enablement plan 6) Feedback loop. Pls comment.

Jorge L: Also need the customer's IP ranges for firewall pre-approval. Can someone ask them in the pre-meeting?

Priya S: I'll add renewal milestones to Notion and tag product usage KPIs. Request: capture 3 sample prompts from their dev team for quality monitoring.

Sam T: Quick test command for SSO probe I use: curl -X GET 'https://nimbus.example.com/auth/test' -H 'Authorization: SAML <token>' -- happy to share exact steps in a doc.

Sam T: Also tagging @jess-devops — can you confirm GPU pool availability for pilot week of 4/24?

Jess (external): Confirmed — reserved gpu-pool-dedicated-1 for 4/24-4/30. :white_check_mark:

Alex R: Perfect. Treat the first two weeks as an "integration window" with daily async check-ins in this thread for blockers. If something blocks the SLA flag it here and we'll escalate. :eyes:

Devin P: FYI legal asked for a sample DPA + SSO assertion. I'll attach docs to CS-4821 when ready.

Maya C: I'll send the calendar invites + the pre-meeting checklist (ask for metadata, IP ranges, test user, and 3 sample prompts). See you all tomorrow. :handshake:
